instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What are the eligibility requirements for admission to B.Tech Artificial Intelligence?
output: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science with minimum 60% aggregate marks (55% for reserved categories). Admission is through state/national engineering entrance examinations (such as MHT-CET, JEE Main) followed by centralized counseling.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: Can I take admission in B.Tech AI if I scored 58% in 10+2 general category?
output: No. The general category requires a minimum of 60% aggregate marks in 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science. The 55% relaxation is only applicable to recognized reserved category candidates.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What is the annual tuition fee for the engineering programs?
output: The annual tuition fee for the B.Tech program is INR 1,65,000 per academic year, plus INR 4,000 examination fee, INR 6,000 lab maintenance, and a refundable INR 10,000 security deposit. Applicable government scholarships and fee waivers are honored.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What is the college attendance requirement? What happens if my attendance is 68%?
output: The department enforces a mandatory 75% attendance policy. If your attendance is between 65% and 74%, you must submit legitimate medical certificates to the HOD for conditional examination hall ticket approval; otherwise you are debarred.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: How are grades evaluated in semester examinations?
output: The department uses a 10-point CGPA system with 40% Continuous Internal Assessment (two 20-mark In-Sem tests, quizzes, practical continuous evaluation) and 60% End-Semester University Examination.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: Which elective specializations can students choose from?
output: Students can pick from four elective tracks starting in Semester 5: 1) Deep Learning & Generative AI, 2) Autonomous Robotics & Edge AI, 3) Cloud Computing & MLOps, and 4) Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: Who is the Head of Department (HOD) and when can students meet him?
output: The Head of Department is Dr. Rajesh K. Sharma (Office: Room 304, Third Floor, Technology Block). Official student office hours are Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 3:30 PM to 5:00 PM. Contact email: hod.ai@department.ac.in.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What GPU and lab infrastructure does the department provide?
output: The department features four specialized computing labs equipped with NVIDIA RTX 4090 and A100 GPU clusters, Edge-AI Jetson workstations, 10 Gbps networking, and 24/7 research cloud sandbox access.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What are the placement statistics for the AI department?
output: The department has a 92% placement rate, with the highest package at 34 LPA and an average package of 8.6 LPA in the previous academic year. An 8-week summer internship after the 6th semester is mandatory.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What technical festivals and hackathons happen annually?
output: The department organizes 'AI-Conflux', a national 36-hour hackathon and symposium every February, 'NeurOlympics' sports & cultural week in October, and monthly industry masterclasses.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: How can I apply for re-evaluation of my exam papers?
output: Submit a re-evaluation request via the Student Examination Portal within 7 working days of result declaration with a fee of INR 500 per subject. Non-academic issues are handled by the Grievance Redressal Committee.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: Can students access research databases like IEEE Xplore from home?
output: Yes, institutional off-campus and on-campus access to IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, SpringerLink, and ScienceDirect is provided via university library proxy credentials to all registered students.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: Can you book a movie ticket for me?
output: I am an official Department FAQ Assistant. I can only assist with academic, admission, curriculum, faculty, and departmental administrative inquiries. Your request is outside my operational scope.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: What is the recipe for chocolate cake?
output: I specialize strictly in Department FAQs (academics, admissions, faculty, facilities, and campus policies). I cannot assist with non-departmental topics.

instruction: Answer the department inquiry with official academic department facts.
input: My name is John Doe and my phone number is 9876543210. Can you save my details?
output: Under department safety and privacy policy, I do not store, log, or persist any personal identifiable information (PII) such as personal names, phone numbers, or private credentials.
